title: Anjaan paisa aaya, call aaya? Ye jump deposit scam hai
hooks: Account mein anjaan ₹50,000 aaya? Ruko, wapas mat bhejna.
Kisi ne galat paisa bheja? Wapas bhejne se pehle ye dekh lo.
Bank se anjaan credit aaya? Ye naya scam hai, bach ke raho.
hook_why: Opens with specific amount + immediate stop command; mirrors top finance shorts that lead with concrete threat and action in first 3 seconds.
metaphor: Money mule trap: unexpected credit is bait; returning it makes you a layer in the laundering chain.

messages.text: Rs 5,000.00 credited to a/c XX4821 by VPA rkumar88@ybl. UPI Ref 6620 1188 4431.
+91 98xxx xx210 · 'Bhai galti se paise bhej diye'

scenes.vo: Account mein anjaan ₹5,000 aaye, aur call aaya, galti se bhej diya? Ruko.

scenes.title: Sanchar Saathi advisory
scenes.sub: Jump Deposit Fraud · DoT · SBI alert 10 Oct 2026
lines: Phir call: 'galti se bheja, wapas karo'
Collect request pe PIN mangte hain
scenes.vo: Ye jump deposit scam hai. Sanchar Saathi aur SBI dono iski warning de chuke hain.

scenes.title: SCAM KAISE HOTA HAI
scenes.vo: Pehle chhota amount, phir call, aur wapas karne ka dabaav.

scenes.sub: Collect request: PIN daala toh ₹5,000 TUMHARE jaayenge
scenes.vo: Wo collect request bhejta hai. PIN daala, toh paisa tumhare hi account se jaata hai.

scenes.sub: paisa lene ke liye PIN kabhi nahi
scenes.vo: Yaad rakho, paisa lene ke liye UPI PIN kabhi nahi lagta.

scenes.title: SCREENSHOT vs BANK APP
scenes.vo: Kabhi sirf fake screenshot aata hai. Apne bank app mein khud balance dekho.

scenes.title: Rakesh (Unknown)

messages.text: Apne bank se reverse karwa lo. Main kuch nahi bhejunga.

scenes.vo: Paisa sach mein aaya ho, tab bhi khud mat bhejo. Usse apne bank se reverse karwane bolo.

scenes.title: REPORT KARO
scenes.vo: Shak ho toh 1930 pe call karo, ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.
Save karo, kaam aayega. Tumhe kabhi aisa call aaya hai?

caption:
Account mein anjaan paisa aaya aur call aaya 'galti se bheja'? Ruko 🛑
Ye jump deposit scam hai. Paisa lene ke liye UPI PIN kabhi nahi lagta. Screenshot pe nahi, apne bank app pe balance dekho. Khud wapas mat bhejo: usse bolo apne bank se reverse karwaye.
Shak ho toh 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in / Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).
Source: Sanchar Saathi (DoT) advisory; SBI alert, 10 Oct 2026
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

claims.claim: Scammers deposit money then ask victim to return via QR/UPI
claims.basis: Legal Warning India article on Online Refund Scam 2026; documented scam pattern

claims.claim: Returning the money makes you a money mule layer in laundering chain
claims.basis: Cybercrime investigation pattern: police trace transaction to return sender; scammer remains hidden

claims.claim: RBI guideline: do not return unknown credits, inform bank
claims.basis: RBI circulars on customer protection and unauthorized transactions; standard banking ombudsman advice

claims.claim: Report to bank immediately and cybercrime.gov.in for account freezing and recovery
claims.basis: Aseem Juneja guide: bank complaint within 24-48 hours + cybercrime portal for account freezing and recovery
